tool.name: DtedHeaderReport

param.name: input
param.dialogReference: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><DIV><P><SPAN>A DTED file (.dt0, .dt1, .dt2) or a folder of them.</SPAN></P></DIV></DIV></DIV>

param.name: report_format
param.dialogReference: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><DIV><P><SPAN>text (aligned columns), json (every field with its raw and decoded value), csv (one row per field) or md (Markdown tables).</SPAN></P></DIV></DIV></DIV>

param.name: output_file
param.dialogReference: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><DIV><P><SPAN>Where to write the report. Without it, a text report is shown in the messages.</SPAN></P></DIV></DIV></DIV>

param.name: check_data
param.dialogReference: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><DIV><P><SPAN>Also check the elevation records: the 0xAA sentinel, block and line counts, the checksum of every record, and the share of null posts against the partial cell indicator.</SPAN></P></DIV></DIV></DIV>

param.name: zero_based
param.dialogReference: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><DIV><P><SPAN>Count byte positions from 0, as a hex editor does, instead of the specification's 1.</SPAN></P></DIV></DIV></DIV>

tool.summary: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><DIV><P><SPAN>Reports every field of the User Header Label (UHL), Data Set Identification (DSI) and Accuracy Description (ACC) records of DTED files as a table (Start, End, Length, Title, Value, Description), with the level evidence, a summary and the MIL-PRF-89020B findings (errors, warnings, information). Byte positions are the specification's one-based character positions unless zero-based counting is chosen. Accuracy subregions are decoded, and the elevation records can be checked for sentinels, block and line counts, checksums and the share of null posts. The same report is available on the command line as "egmtrans dted-header".</SPAN></P></DIV></DIV></DIV>
tool.usage: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><DIV><UL><LI><P><SPAN>Reads the header from raw bytes, so a .aux.xml sidecar or a GDAL default cannot hide a problem.</SPAN></P></LI><LI><P><SPAN>A folder is searched for .dt0, .dt1 and .dt2 files; one report follows another.</SPAN></P></LI><LI><P><SPAN>Findings: an error breaks readers or a mandatory rule (NUL bytes, a wrong interval for the latitude zone, mismatched counts); a warning is a deviation readers tolerate (NA right justified, E08, a producer code without a country prefix).</SPAN></P></LI><LI><P><SPAN>With a report file, the report is written there in the chosen format; without one, a text report is shown in the messages.</SPAN></P></LI></UL></DIV></DIV></DIV>

scriptExample.title: DTED Header Report
scriptExample.para: <DIV STYLE="text-align:Left;"><DIV><P><SPAN>On the command line:</SPAN></P><P><SPAN>egmtrans dted-header N55.dt2 --check-data</SPAN></P><P><SPAN>egmtrans dted-header E038 --format csv --out headers.csv</SPAN></P><P><SPAN>egmtrans dted-header N55.dt2 --format json --zero-based</SPAN></P></DIV></DIV>
